title:
Epic to validate that {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s selected in 'Reliability.ModelsGrid' for Retrain, all belong to same {@link MlProject}.
If all the selected models belong to same ML project, open 'Reliability.BulkRetrainModelsModal',
else inform the user of the error by opening 'Reliability.RetrainErrorModal'.
name: ValidateModelsHaveSameMlProjectEpic
